title: Maps Within Maps
author: Claude
blurb: Three short scenes about links between maps of different sizes. Yana starts on a world map where a whole town is one block and they are tiny. Step on the town and its streets open up at a bigger scale. A house door leads into a room. Each way in has a way back that puts Yana where they came from: beside the town block, or outside the door. A locked gate sends them back to the world map for a key. Signs say how. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and look at a scene's links.

box.tagline: From the world to a room.
box.back: A small explorer in a pink beanie crosses a world map where a town is one block, steps onto it and walks the streets, then goes in at a house door. Every way in has a way back to the right spot, and a locked gate sends them back out to the world for a key. Read the signs, then open the game in Game-Maker and look at a scene's links.
features: Signs in the scenes explain each idea
A world, a town and a house, each at its own scale
Links that land you where you came from
Made to be copied and taken apart
